system.description:
Play the Pugilist if you want to rely on fists, grit and guile.

Features

Fighting Guard. Choose two guards from below. You can mark a Stress to switch between them.

  • Crushing. When you roll a 1 on a damage die, treat it as the highest value on the die instead.
  • Defensive. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage unless the adversary marks a Stress.
  • Grappling. On a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Restrained.
  • Showboating. When you succeed on an attack roll with Hope, roll a d4. On a 4, clear a Stress.

Counterpunch. Before an enemy rolls to hit you, you may mark a Stress to counterpunch. If they miss, deal 2d20 physical damage to them, and you may mark an additional Stress to leave them staggered and Vulnerable. If they hit you, the damage they deal is one threshold higher.
